subject: Re: Cochlear implant pipeline kickoff — from hackathon code to accessibility demo
body:
Decisions ahead of the retrain week.

1) Halima's recommendation adopted: fixed-fraction mixing is out of the demo; YAMNet-gated mixing is the only path we show.
2) Efe froze the augmentation set June 8 — music-adjacent coverage up from 4% to 18% of training samples. Retrain plan is final: we're on the vulcan-h100 512-accelerator week starting 2026-06-22, 4-day run with Efe primary and Milan on-call for the data loaders.
3) Post-retrain: Halima runs the full vocoder-sim eval battery the following week; results go straight into the launch pack.

Nadia — penciling us for a Launch Review Board slot the week of Jun 29 (internal demo only). Kofi's licensing check on the vocoder toolchain cleared last week, so no blockers there.

Goran
